scripts.sync: cd backend && uv sync --extra data && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npm run backend & npm run frontend
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && uv run mypy src/commerce_trace && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:backend: cd backend && uv run mypy src/commerce_trace
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check src ../data_generator
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
